name: cavemio-domain-connect
title: Domain connect
description: A custom domain from typed to live: copyable records that tick green as DNS finds them, checks that wait longer each time, and a rail that runs to Live.

cavemio.accessibility:
- The records are a table with a row per record; each name and value has its own copy button, named after the record ("Copy CNAME value"), whose icon turns into a drawn check.
- Changes in status ("2 of 2 records found", "app.fernhill.co is live") are announced in a status region; the countdown is hidden from screen readers.
- Automatic checks stop when the domain is live, has failed or has been removed, and wait while the page is hidden. A newer check aborts an older one.
- The rail is drawn for the eye only; the status line under the heading says the same in words.
- Reduced motion swaps every state in place: no flight, rises, glows or pings.
cavemio.previewNote: Interactive local fixture. Data and async results are simulated in the preview; the caller supplies application services.

props.name: onAdd
props.description: – · Registers the domain (already cut down to its host) and returns { domain, status, records, message? }. Throw to keep the field and show the message.

props.name: check
props.description: – · Reports what your server sees now. Called on the schedule and by Check now; the signal aborts it when the domain is removed or a newer check starts.

props.name: onRemove
props.description: – · Removes the domain; the card goes back to the field. Without it there is no Remove.

props.name: value
props.description: – · Controlled state. status is "pending", "issuing", "active" or "failed"; each record is { type, name, value, priority?, status? }.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: – · A domain that was already added, when uncontrolled.

props.name: schedule
props.description: [10, 20, 30, 60, 120, 300] · Seconds before each automatic check; the last one repeats. Checks wait while the tab is hidden.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: "app.yourcompany.com" · The field's placeholder and the example in its error.

features.title: Paste a URL, get a domain
features.description: A pasted address is cut down to its host. Anything that is not a domain shakes the field and says so.

features.title: Records you can copy
features.description: Each record opens with its own copy buttons, named after the record, such as “Copy CNAME value”.

features.title: It checks again by itself
features.description: Checks wait longer each time and never run while the tab is hidden. “Checking again in 0:42” counts down, and Check now asks at once.

features.title: Records tick green
features.description: Each record turns green the moment your server sees it, and the rail above fills record by record.

features.title: From certificate to Live
features.description: It shows “Issuing certificate”, then Live. The records fold behind “Show records” and the address becomes a link.

features.title: Failures in plain words
features.description: Your server’s message says what is wrong, the wrong record is marked and automatic checks stop.

states.title: add
states.description: A pasted URL becomes its host on paste ("https://App.Fernhill.co/pricing" → "app.fernhill.co"). Anything that isn't a domain shakes the field and says so. Connect turns to Connecting while onAdd runs.

states.title: added
states.description: The field folds away in 480ms while the domain opens; its heading travels 620ms from where the address sat in the field. The records rise in one after another, 70ms apart.

states.title: waiting
states.description: A pinging amber dot says "Waiting for DNS", then "1 of 2 records found". "Checking again in 0:42" rolls down a second at a time; while check() runs it reads "Checking DNS" with a spinner.

states.title: found
states.description: A record that verifies swaps its spinner for a drawn check, says Found and glows green for 1.4s; the rail fills to that record's share of the first step in 760ms.

states.title: certificate
states.description: With every record found the status morphs to "Issuing certificate" and the middle step spins until your server reports the domain active.

states.title: live
states.description: The rail runs to its end, each step draws its check, "Live" turns green, the records fold behind "Show records" and the heading becomes a link to the domain.

states.title: failed
states.description: Your server's message opens under the records in red and automatic checks stop; the wrong record is marked. Check now starts again.
